syllabus_topics: Characterization of electrical energy production and consumption: concepts of energy and power in AC systems
Electrical energy systems as balanced three-phase AC systems: three-phase models of transformers, synchronous machines, asynchronous machines, and transmission line
Introduction to network analysis: simplified models for solving power flow problems (DC model) and short-circuit analysis (symmetrical three-phase faults)
assessment_rules: In the Normal Season, the final grade is calculated based on a final exam (50%), laboratory work (30%), and mini-quizzes in practical classes (20%). In the Resit Season, the final exam accounts for 70% and laboratory work for 30%. Students with a final grade greater than or equal to 18 out of 20 must take an oral exam to maintain that grade, otherwise, they will be assigned 18. The final exam has a minimum grade of 8.0, and the laboratory work has a minimum grade of 9.5.
